includeActiveStory.description: Include the currently live public story snaps with media and preview URLs.
includeActiveStory.title: Include active story snaps

includeComments.description: Include the public comment threads Snapchat embeds on the profile page. Full thread pagination is a separate actor.
includeComments.title: Include embedded Spotlight comments

includeHighlightSnaps.description: Add the full snap list to each curated highlight. Can make records much larger.
includeHighlightSnaps.title: Include every highlight snap

includeLenses.description: Include lenses published by the profile.
includeLenses.title: Include AR lenses

includeSpotlightMeta.description: Merge each Spotlight's view, share, comment, boost and recommend counts, caption, hashtags and AI metadata into the record.
includeSpotlightMeta.title: Include Spotlight metadata

maxHighlightsPerUser.description: Cap curated highlights and Spotlight slots per profile. 0 excludes both. Leave blank for no limit.
maxHighlightsPerUser.title: Max highlights per profile

maxItems.description: Stop after this many profile records. Leave blank for no cap.
maxItems.title: Max profiles

maxRelatedAccounts.description: Cap the related accounts listed inside each record. 0 excludes them. Leave blank for no limit.
maxRelatedAccounts.title: Max related accounts per profile

maxSnapsPerHighlight.description: Used only when includeHighlightSnaps is on. 0 means no limit; 1-500 caps each highlight.
maxSnapsPerHighlight.title: Max snaps per highlight

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Public Snapchat profiles work without a proxy.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

relatedProfilesLimit.description: After the supplied profiles, scrape up to this many unique accounts from their related lists (one hop only). 0 disables expansion.
relatedProfilesLimit.title: Scrape related profiles

usernames.description: Snapchat usernames or profile URLs. Accepts brentrivera, @brentrivera, https://www.snapchat.com/add/brentrivera and https://www.snapchat.com/@brentrivera.
usernames.title: Usernames or profile URLs
